notes.title: Play together with your AI!
notes.content: Play the Pong with two balls, let your AI assist you!

notes.title: Bug fixed and Advance Rocket landing
notes.content:
Some bugs were fixed
Now you can enjoy sending the rocket to the correct location and landing it down.

notes.title: Emergent bug fix
notes.content:
Seems the Steam API fails, causing the game menu failed to load. 
Time is needed to fix it.
A development build was uploaded and seems the menu can be shown. Any feedback is warmly welcome and appreciated !

notes.title: Major Revision-Sensor
notes.content:
Enhance the neural system by adding sensors! You can now unlock sensors in the warehouse section of the office. After unlocking, use the new "Sensor" button in the neural network builder to activate the sensors.

I've also introduced a new task involving a simple rocket landing. Three different sensors are available at various price points, each offering different costs to complete the task.
